paragraphs.text: Lammasu is a creature type for a species with the body of a bull , a bird 's wings and a human head with horns.
So far, three lammasu have been printed, all associated with white mana.
Lammasu are based on depictions of Mesopotamian goddess Lammasu .
The creature type first appeared on Hunted Lammasu in Ravnica: City of Guilds . The type would return in Khans of Tarkir on Venerable Lammasu , and in Murders at Karlov Manor on Absolving Lammasu .
Ravnican lammasu once ruled the velds of the plane before the arrival of the urban sprawl. Only a few remain alive today, flying in its skies while being hunted by horrors.
Tarkir lammasu are enigmatic nomads, soaring high above the land across all seasons. None know of their true purpose, but they arrive frequently at turning points of history.
